newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 15.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 15.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker quotes edged higher on firmer swaps quotes although enquiries were average, traders said. They said offers just edged higher on firm swaps with no fundamental change in demand and supply. "Some shipowners are now waiting for weaker prices as the rise is seen to be temporary," said one major. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
